It was the punishment imposed on the Portuguese striker for leaving the team's training camp without permission. Jesus kept him on the bench for one match and said he did not plan to start him in the next, so Ronaldo went home. His last appearance came on 24 September against Wales. He ends his international career with 146 goals in 234 games. A message went around Portugal with a big thank you for everything, calling Ronaldo a global ambassador and an inspiration to millions. Even so, the way it ended leaves a bit of a bitter taste. Was he going to be named in the next squad? Possibly, as Jesus said the door was open and the decision was Ronaldo's. He reacted the way he always has when a coach questions his place. But the label hides how much he adapted over the years.
